notes.title: We are participating in Autumn sale and Steam award nomination
notes.content:
How do you do fellow steamers? 

We are happy to say that we are participating in Steam Autumn sale and in Steam award nomination. 

We have been working on our game for quite a while now and got some feedback from players that helped us change a lot of things in the game, one of which is the UI. 

We were happy to receive positive feedback which has among other things praised our graphical style of the game! That's why we decided to participate in the Steam awards nomination for the Visual Style, as we feel that it "distinctive look and feel that suffuses an entire game" as the nomination says. 

We are continuing our works on the game and if you feel that the style is catching your eye you can now smash that Visual Style button! ːsteamthumbsupː

Thanks for your support, The Wicked Days team. ːduckyː

notes.title: The Wicked Days major update and sale! Gamepad support, GUI rework.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787256/ad1ccbbf07b0936bc96e904938558e42ed851078.png

 Major update 

 The Wicked Days, our top-down zombie shooter is having a major update! To celebrate this, the game is on sale.

Thanks to your feedback and support, we have reworked GUI and HUD and now you can play our game using gamepad!

Our game The Wicked Days is having our first big update!

A lot has changed since version that we released for the first time to early access. 

Thanks for writing us bug reports and your feedback and for your steam reviews!

After acquiring enough feedback we have reworked the graphical user interface, added item description and stats. Heads-up display is also updated, players now are able to see status effects even better, also player now is warned if his health is too low.

We received lots of questions about controllers support and although we already were working on it, we have moved it up in the priority list and with this update it is possible to play The Wicked Days with a gamepad!

We have also added more enemy encounters, more loot and items to the map!

We hope you will enjoy this update!  We will continue to listen to feedback, tweak stuff and add new things.  

Now lets see what we have done in this update in detail:

Major changes:

 Added controller support

 Added new display for when the player is taking damage

 Added display of low player health 

 The inventory has been reworked with a new design and new interface 

 Now there is a window with information about the item, when you hover over it 

 Now there are tooltips when using items that affect the characteristics of the character

 Added the ability to use items directly from the inventory (with double click and a specially made button) 

 Status effects (Bleeding, Burning, Stun) are now displayed directly above the character's head 

 More enemies have been added to the map, now they are encountered more often

 More items and weapons have been added to the map, now they are more common

 Increased car survivability, now it's more fun to crush zombies




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787256/8a5d54146d174663fe50d80ac7d1a587037a50d5.jpg

Other changes:


 Cosmetic changes in the main menu before starting the game

 Added some missing item icons 

 Added some steps in learning at the start of the game


Bug fixes:


 Fixed a bug with the automatic launch of VR at the start of the game, if it was present on the computer
 Fixed bugs that sometimes would occur with body armor - in rare cases some of the armor would not work when the character picked it up
 Fixed some inventory errors (locking the mouse when firing after exiting the inventory, inability to open the inventory immediately after exiting the inventory) 
 Fixed inventory bugs when using supplies directly from the inventory 
 Fixed bugs of behavior of cars that would sometimes occur 
 Fixed an issue where zombies could sometimes appear sleepy and not react to what was happening around them
 Fixed an issue with loading after death before the player finds the first Ducknet booth
 Fixed a problem with pressing LMB to skip the starting video - sometimes this partially would lock controls 
 Fixed some bugs in action volumes (sometimes they could serve as invisible obstacles for shooting)
 Fixed a bug with the appearance of the military near the trailer park (sometimes they did not appear)
 Fixed a bug when sometimes items would appear higher than necessary above ground
 Fixed a bug when sometimes items would appear only after a long time

notes.title: The Wicked Days is now available in early access on Steam!
Changing release time of the game and a little about the game itself
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787256/99a272fc1db14de35bc84099e6294fce646f38d2.jpg

 Changing release time of the game and a little about the game itself

Good day to everyone who reads us and is interested in our game The Wicked Days, thanks for your support!

About two months before the release, we realized that the map we had was not of proper quality. In order to deliver a more interesting product, we decided to completely redo the landscape. In addition, we collected feedback during the open test period. We saw that it works, but decided that we could take a chance and make a more interesting map of a higher quality.

We understood that we needed to postpone the release date and therefore in all interviews we said that the old date was set a year ago, for the most part in connection with the requirements of the incentive to participate in the Steam Summer game festival. 

We are going into Early Access mostly because restoring content on a new map takes more resources and time than we initially anticipated. In addition this will allow us to interact more closely with the community and discuss new content, receiving feedback. Besides, this will allow players to be even more involved in the development of the game.

In terms of early access, we would like to release big updates about every two months.

We have some plans for content for heroes and quests that we would like to implement first.

You are welcome to our discord to hang out, ask questions and be closer to the development of the game!

notes.title: We are working on: stealth system and finishing moves!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787256/8b849b35c761468b3e7a10f0fc12c284ffd48bec.png

 We are actively working on a new update!
We have made some changes and additions to our inside game build.

After some more testing and bug fixing we will roll out the update to the public.

Players will have finishing moves, can be sneaky or can be loud and can gun while they run.

Zombies will be able hear noises and have line of sight! 

The rest of the parts of the future update are described below indetail. 

Major changes:

Player is now able to shoot on the run
Added finishing moves 
Added partial controller support 
Improved AI for military soldiers and zombies
Added stealth system:
[olist]
Mobs now can hear noise and have line of sight
All mobs can be killed with stealth move from behind
Melee and range weapons now make noises
Stealth kills do not make noises
Running makes noises
Player now can sneak 
If player sneaks, less noise is made
[/olist]
Added new mob type: "military radio operator"
If you trigger the radio operator, he triggers all the mobs in his group. The radio operator will be a separate type of mob in the group (visually different).
Added a perk that allows you to see the line of sight of mobs. 
The line of sight is a cone with a view on the ground. 
Added reaction speed to enemies at which they notice the character if one is spotted in the line of sight


Other changes : 

 Added roll move [“Q” button] 
 Accelerated unarmed character turning 
 Updated the boss model 



Corrections and bugfixes:



 Fixed a bug where aiming sometimes would not work
 Fixed a bug where cars could disappear after respawning
 Fixed a bug where the sound of a zombie bite would play when the character hits any object
 Fixed a bug where the game would freeze after a character crashed into a certain fence in the city
 Fixed a bug where the character could sometimes not get into the car
 Fixed a bug where the finishing blow was triggered even when the enemy was behind the character
 Fixed an issue where the area of ​​interaction with objects overlapped
 Fixed a bug where the character appeared on the platform after leaving the bunker
 Fixed a bug where infinite loading appeared during character respawn
 Fixed some bugs related to bossfight
 Fixed a problem with raising the key card in the bunker
 Fixed a bug where zombies sometimes would not explode on mines
 Fixed a bug where you could turn and jump while capturing an enemy
 Fixed a bug where enemies sometimes would not attack the car in which the character was
 Fixed a bug where zombies and the military stopped attacking the character after the appearance of any dialog box
 Fixed a bug where zombies did not die without limbs, including their heads during the quest "Unevacuation plan"
 Fixed several bugs related to moving units

notes.title: CHANGES AND BUGFIXES
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37787256/7d4e234ffad765043dad286174ca7bf642b21349.png

Hello all! We would like to tell you what we have been working on recently.
Below is a whole list of changes, additions and bug fixes.

Major changes


 Added a boss - a genetically modified Monsardo fighter without tech modifications.
 Added pause when pressing "ESC" and minimizing the game
 Added conditions under which the quest can be failed
 Quest UI can now be turned off using "U" button
 AI improved:
 Once having taken the trail of a character, the military and zombies now do not lose sight of him, unless he is at a respectable distance.
 When the character changes his position, getting out of the car, the military who lost sight of him (if the car hid him) take aim at the back of the car and go there in search of the character.
 If the military had been triggered, they would no longer walk, they would only run.
 The military now fires short bursts of 3-5 rounds
 The military no longer fires when an ally is in the way, but simply bypasses fire from another angle.
 A new type of behaviour: Flock. A flock is a function that unites several enemies into a group with a common pattern of behavior and reacting to an attack on one of the group members.


 We have changed the state of the car and how it behaves when it receives damage:
 100% - 21% - the car stays as it is: rides, does not burn, everything is ok
20% - 11% - the car smokes, does not burn, DOES NOT RIDE, if this happens while driving, it just starts rolling by inertia (does not respond to pressing controls, but the hand brake - space bar - works)
10% - 1% - it burns, the integrity continues to decrease by itself, the hood falls off, upon reaching 0% integrity, the car explodes



 Project has been updated to UE 4.25.3

 The interaction with the car has been changed. To get into the car, you need to press "F", and to refuel - hold down the "F" button for a few seconds




Corrections and bugfixes


 Changed the music during bossfight
 Created an "arena" for the boss battle
 Increased the volume of car sounds
 Changed physics of zombies, now when knocked down by a car they might fly apart
 Fixed a bug where the canister did not disappear from the ground after the character picked it up
 Fixed a bug in which the wheels remained in their original position after the explosion of the car (they did not move and it was possible to walk through them)
 Fixed a bug where the crosshair turned red after being hovered over the wheels
 Fixed a bug where zombies and soldiers got stuck in a moving car
 Fixed a bug where the spare parts that were collected before accepting the quest “Better than new! Part I”, were not included in the quest
 Fixed a bug where weapons remained hanging in the air after killing soldiers
 Fixed a bug where parts were added after picking up the quest for shotgun
 Fixed some bugs related to collisions
 Fixed a bug where killing soldiers did not count towards completing the quest
 Fixed some bugs related to quests
 Added the ability to start the next quest not only in case of successful completion of the previous one, but also in case of failure.
 Fixed a bug where blood would displayed incorrectly on the wheels of the car while driving
 Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when pressing “ESC” when selecting a character
 Fixed a bug where the car could drive through certain parts of static cars
 Fixed a bug where the amount of HP of the car was indicated incorrectly
 Fixed a bug where weapons sometimes disappeared from the character's hands
